No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS

purpose.summary: This program is a subprogram within the ORCA JMA (Japan Medical Association) standard medical receipt software system. It performs comprehensive check processing for 'Houkatu' (comprehensive/bundled) medical treatment billing, validating billing codes, calculation periods, hospitalization fees, and related master data. It handles multiple processing modes including full check, auto-generation check, error deletion, and hospitalization fee calculation checks.
purpose.domain: healthcare/medical billing (Japanese national health insurance receipt processing)

notable_features: Japanese-language comments encoded in latin-1 (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS garbled)
Multiple COPY statements referencing domain-specific copybooks (CPHKTSANTEI.INC, CPHKTSRYCD.INC, CPSANTEI.INC, CPNYUINACCT.INC, etc.)
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple passed areas (SPA, screen SPA, check parameter areas)
OCCURS tables up to 600 entries for billing check master data
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — database access via MCP (middleware call pattern with MCP-TABLE, MCP-RC)
EVALUATE used for multi-mode dispatch (syori codes 1-6)
Open Source license header (JMA Open Source License)
Version history spanning 2007–2017 with Japanese revision notes
verdict.notes: The file is genuine production COBOL from the open-source ORCA medical receipt system developed by JMA (Japan Medical Association). Japanese comments are garbled due to latin-1 decoding of what is likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoding. The database access pattern uses an MCP middleware layer (PERFORM 910-DBSELECT-SEC with MCP-TABLE/MCP-RC fields) rather than embedded SQL. The COPY statements reference many domain-specific copybooks that are not shown. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 120223 bytes total.
